payout_quote: 'Best CD Rates up to 4.48% APY* | Earn Up To $1,000' — *APY accurate as of September 22, 2026. Per Raisin's official September 2026 bonus terms: first deposit initiated September 1-30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET; funds deposited within 14 days of the initial deposit and maintained with partner banks for 90 days are eligible; 'Bonus payouts will be credited directly to the Referrer's and Referee's Cash Accounts within 30 days of satisfying all requirements.' CD boost: $10,000-$24,999 earns an additional $10; $25,000-$49,999 +$25; $50,000-$99,999 +$50; $100,000-$199,999 +$75; $200,000+ +$100.
timing: Bonus credited to the Raisin Cash Account within 30 days of satisfying all requirements. Qualifying deposits must be initiated September 1-30, 2026 and maintained with partner banks for 90 days from the initial deposit date.
eligibility: New Raisin customers, 18+, US resident. Register between September 1 and September 30, 2026 (referral path uses the referrer's unique code; STACK path uses promo code STACK). $1 minimum opening deposit; bonus tiers start at $10,000 deposited within 14 days of the initial deposit and held continuously for 90 days.
biggest_catch: The promo window closes September 30, 2026 — after that the bonus may not exist — and it requires locking real money for 90 days minimum inside a CD (early withdrawal penalties apply), so your cash is illiquid for months.
catches: Bonus window ends September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET — the offer may disappear after that date.
Qualifying funds must be deposited within 14 days of the initial deposit and maintained for 90 days; if the balance dips, you drop to the tier matching the lowest balance maintained.
CDs lock your money for the term — early withdrawal penalties apply per the partner bank's terms.
Raisin is not an FDIC-insured bank itself; insurance covers only failure of the insured partner bank, and Raisin holds no customer funds (custodial model).
Interest rate and APY may change after initial deposit depending on the specific product selected.
steps: Go to https://www.raisin.com/en-us/cd-accounts/ and register a new Raisin account between September 1 and September 30, 2026 (use the applicable promo code, e.g. STACK).
Make your first deposit within the window and fund at least $10,000 into a CD within 14 days of the initial deposit to reach a bonus tier.
For the Savings + CD Boost, put at least $1,000 into a second product category (a CD category) within 14 days and keep balances over $1,000 in both categories through day 90.
Maintain all qualifying balances continuously for 90 days from the initial deposit date.
The bonus (Welcome Bonus plus any CD boost, up to $1,000) is credited to your Raisin Cash Account within 30 days of satisfying all requirements.
